title: Run, approve and stop one slice from the CLI
lead:
The daemon runs S04's engine with S16's adapter, and the CLI launches,
approves, answers and stops one slice (`engine.owner-surface`).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** waves, caps, the Waves screen, or TUI actions.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: With it, the owner can run ork's own slices through ork (dogfood).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/`, `internal/ipc/`, `internal/cli/`, `docs/design.md`
  (CLI and Output), and the glue from the engine's Runner to the claude
  adapter.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `ork run P ID` prints the plan (worktree, branch, check command, lineup
  from `relay-roles recommend --json` with the first Claude row per role,
  allowlists) and starts only after confirmation; `--yes` skips the
  prompt. That is checkpoint 1.
- `ork approve RUN` commits a slice awaiting approval (checkpoint 2);
  `ork stop RUN` stops it and kills its roles; `ork answer RUN TEXT`
  resumes a paused role with the answer.
- `ork status` lists engine runs with state and what they wait on;
  `needs_you` adds awaiting approval, paused and stopped runs
  (`status.needs-you`).
- The daemon does not idle-exit while a run is active (`daemon.idle`).
- Fakes only; the daemon runs in-process.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` clean; SPDX headers;
  no new dependency.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner runs one small ork slice end to end with
  `ork run ork ID` and approves it.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S17: run, approve and stop one slice from the CLI".
